void-canvas.$description: Void Canvas — Page background, deepest surface — near-black, the floor everything else sits on

carbon-plate.$description: Carbon Plate — Primary card surface, one step above the canvas — the dominant elevated panel

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Secondary card surface, code blocks, nested panels

iron-edge.$description: Iron Edge — Mid-tier surface, dividers, hover overlays on dark surfaces

steel-border.$description: Steel Border — Heavy structural borders, button outlines on dark, nav separators

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary text, filled pill button fill, icon strokes — the only high-luminance neutral

cloud-mist.$description: Cloud Mist — Secondary text, soft fills, muted surface highlights

fog.$description: Fog — Card hairline borders — counterintuitively light on the dark canvas, defining card edges by luminosity contrast

ash.$description: Ash — Body text secondary, muted descriptions, helper text

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary body text, subdued labels, disabled-ish state

slate-mute.$description: Slate Mute — Nav borders, inactive nav text, structural dividers in chrome

cinder.$description: Cinder — Deep muted text, low-priority links, icon rest state

phosphor-mint.$description: Phosphor Mint — Accent card fill, highlight surfaces — the signature brand glow, reserved for featured cards and stat panels

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Link borders, active link text, focus accents — the interface's action stroke

ice-blue.$description: Ice Blue — Decorative soft borders, light accent strokes on cards

current-blue.$description: Current Blue — Active nav state, selected menu items, current-page indicator

deep-signal.$description: Deep Signal — Input focus border, form active state, info semantic stroke

verdant-edge.$description: Verdant Edge — Green accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

steel-iris.$description: Steel Iris — Card decorative borders with cool blue-gray tint, secondary card outlines

geist.$description: Body, UI, and navigation typeface. Geist handles all functional text: body copy at 16px/1.50, nav items at 14-15px, button labels at 14-16px, captions at 12px. Tight negative tracking (-0.017em to -0.020em) at display sizes creates density; positive tracking (0.042-0.094em) at 8-10px gives badge and micro-text an uppercase stencil feel.

calsans.$description: Display and heading typeface. Calsans is a condensed, geometric sans with positive tracking (0.056em) that makes headlines feel engineered rather than editorial — letters spread apart like instrument panel labels. Weight 300 used at largest sizes creates an anti-confident presence: massive, airy, never shouting. Weight 600 appears in mid-size headings for grounding.

helvetica.$description: Helvetica — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
